title: Threats against Asberg and his family over the Baltic Sea anomaly

tellings.quote: Uh not really, but you know, you get mails and and like threatening me and my kids and and uh lots of things like that.

plain: A Swedish treasure hunter named Dennis Asberg, whose team found an odd shape on the Baltic seafloor in 2011, says he has been sent emails threatening him and his children because of it. He tells Michels this about his own life, playing it down as just "lots of things like that".
